literal_meaning: এক কালীন (একবারের জন্য বা অস্থায়ী সময়ের)
figurative_meaning_en: Once and for all or for one time only
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সুযোগটি এককালীন, আর কোনোদিন পাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: This opportunity is one-time; you won't get it again.
The government has given a one-time waiver.
note: Often used in bureaucratic or official contexts in Bengali-speaking regions.
